column1: # BabelSoft Script Data: Miyake Phonetic Tables

#   the N-th element in each table to resolve the indices from
#   1. key          - Table key: initial-N | medial-N | final-N
#   2. miyake2015   - Phonetic value in Miyake 2015 reconstruction
#   3. miyake2012   - Phonetic value in Miyake 2012 reconstruction
